headline: Kodak's SlideTag photo frame doubles as an AirTag-style tracker
summary: Kodak's new SlideTag is a tiny digital photo frame that also functions as a tracker, similar to an AirTag. It follows Reto's small Kodak Charmera camera, and the SlideTag will be sold in a blind box with nine different designs.
